notes: New bottom tabs: Matches, Fantasy, Lab and Alerts
Fantasy tab: every upcoming and live match, straight to its fantasy picks
Alerts tab: choose which match alerts you get
"Lineup Out" tag once the playing XIs are named
Matches open on Live or Upcoming; the side menu no longer hides behind the tabs
Tabs along the bottom: Matches, Results, Lab and Account
Swipe left or right to move between a match's tabs
An "XIs in" tag on every match, which updates by itself when the teams are named
New alerts: a match starting soon, today's matches, results, and the captain in the XIs alert
The menu opens from your profile icon, in place of the three lines
Match screens no longer have a share button at the top
The update prompt waits until the app has opened and lists what's new
Plainer headings across the match screens
Tabs renamed: Venue, and Batter v bowler
The app tells you when a new version is out
Version number in the side menu and settings
Share the app opens Android's share sheet
Match alerts work on Android 13 and later, and show while the app is open
